title: StyleDocument
description: The style IR as a document: a format version and the map (ADR-0013).

oneOf.description: Along the line.
Along the line, and never upside down.
Following the line's curve, character by character.

Bound.description:
A style property that may vary by feature: a value, a property bound as MapServer binds an
attribute, or an expression (ADR-0015). It is read as an untagged enum would read it, a value
before an expression, but an object by its keys, so that a key it does not know is named.

anyOf.description:
The feature's property `binding`, read as MapServer's `bindStyle` reads an attribute: a
number with C's `atof`, a label's integer properties as the property says (`bindLabel`), a
colour as `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, or three integers separated by spaces, each with C's
`atoi`. An empty value leaves a number at the value `bindStyle` sets before it reads one,
which for a size, an outline width, or an angle is not the value the property has without
the binding (docs/semantics/binding.md), and a colour that does not read leaves no colour.

expression.description: Which features the class draws; without one, every feature that reaches it.

min_scale_denom.description: The class draws at a scale from `min_scale_denom` up to below `max_scale_denom`.

Expr.description:
An expression: a literal, a property of the feature, a list, a time, or an operator or
function applied to its arguments. It is read by the keys of its object, as CQL2-JSON tells
its alternatives apart, so that a key it does not know is named like any other field.

FeatureProperty.description: A property of an inline feature.

oneOf.description: The label and its styles are placed together or not at all.
The first point of a line.
The last point of a line.
Every point of a line but the first and the last.

The bounding box of the shape in pixels, each side held within the image grown by the
style's width or size, whichever is larger, and 3 pixels, drawn as a polygon is.

A label's transform, [`LabelTransform::Point`], which a class's style of a line or a
polygon layer draws nothing at.

A label's transform, [`LabelTransform::Poly`], which a class's style of a line or a
polygon layer draws nothing at.

A label's transform, [`LabelTransform::Center`], which a class's style of a line or a
polygon layer draws nothing at.

An expression of shape functions, its transform tree (ADR-0037),
which the engine does not draw on a class's style: a class's style of it in a line or a
polygon layer draws nothing and is reported, its class's other styles drawn as before; a
point layer draws the style at its points, as it draws every style whatever its
transform; a label of a style of it is left out.

InlineFeature.description: A feature written into a layer, a shape as MapServer holds one (ADR-0018).

parts.description:
Its parts, each a list of `[x, y]` in the layer's coordinates: a point shape's points, a
line shape's lines, a polygon shape's rings, an outer ring not told from an inner one.

properties.description:
Its properties, each a string, in order; a reader finds a name without regard to ASCII
case, the first of two that match.

Label.description: A label a class draws for each feature.

align.description:
A bound value is read as MapServer's `bindLabel` reads it: rounded to an integer as a
bound `size` is, which where it is not 0 is taken as MapServer's alignment constant
without a range check (`MS_ALIGN_LEFT` 1, `MS_ALIGN_CENTER` 2, `MS_ALIGN_RIGHT` 3); where
it is 0, a value of at least four characters that begins with `left`, `cente`, or `right`,
compared without case. A value that reads as 0 and matches none, an empty one among them,
leaves the alignment as it stood: the previous feature's, or on the first feature the one
the load left, a keyword `ALIGN` before or after the binding, else `MS_ALIGN_DEFAULT` 0.
What is drawn there is not settled until the engine draws bound label values.

buffer.description: Space kept free around the label, in pixels.

expression.description:
Whether the label is drawn for a feature: its `EXPRESSION`, read as a class's is, with the
layer's `LABELITEM` as the attribute a string, regular expression, or list compares.

font.description: A font of the map's fonts, by name.

min_feature_size.description: The smallest feature labelled, in pixels; `auto`: one the label fits.

min_scale_denom.description: The label is placed at a scale from `min_scale_denom` up to below `max_scale_denom`.

offset.description: `[x, y]`. A bound value is rounded to an integer as a bound `size` is; an empty one is 0.

position.description:
A bound value is read as MapServer's `bindLabel` reads it: rounded to an integer as a
bound `size` is, which where it is not 0 is taken as MapServer's position constant without
a range check (`MS_UL` 101, `MS_LR`, `MS_UR`, `MS_LL`, `MS_CR`, `MS_CL`, `MS_UC`, `MS_LC`,
`MS_CC`, `MS_AUTO` 110); where it is 0, a value of exactly two characters that is one of
`ul` … `lr` and `cc`, compared without case. A value that reads as 0 and matches none, an
empty one among them, leaves the position as it stood: the previous feature's, or on the
first feature the one the load left, `MS_BINDING` (2007) where the binding is the last
`POSITION`, else the last keyword. What is drawn there is not settled until the engine
draws bound label values.

priority.description:
1 to 10; a higher one is placed first. A bound value is rounded to an integer as a bound
`size` is; an empty one is 1.

shadow_color.description:
A colour only, never a binding or an expression: MapServer's `loadLabel` reads it with
`loadColor` and no binding, and refuses a mapfile that binds it.

shadow_size.description:
The shadow's offset, `[x, y]`. A bound value is rounded to an integer as a bound `size`
is; an empty one is 1.

size.description:
The size in points; MapServer's bitmap sizes `tiny` to `giant` stand as 5, 7, 10, 13, 16.
A bound value is rounded to an integer, as MapServer's `bindLabel` reads it with
`bindIntegerAttribute`: `MS_NINT(atof(value))`, `lrint` at the pin, half to even, undefined
past a `long`, and the `long` narrowed to an `int`. An empty value is 1.

styles.description: Drawn with the label, each where its transform says.

text.description: The text: the label's `TEXT`, else the class's, else the layer's `LABELITEM`.

wrap.description: The character at which the text wraps.

LabelTransform.description: Where a label's style draws, which it always names.

oneOf.description: At the label's point: a marker, before the text.
The box around the label's text.
The centre of the box around the label's text: a marker drawn there, before the text.

features.description:
The features written into the layer (ADR-0018). A layer with any is read from them alone,
whatever source it names or a host binds to it.

filter.description: Which of the source's features the layer reads; without one, all of them.

geom_transform.description:
The layer's `GEOMTRANSFORM`, its transform tree (ADR-0037), which
replaces the shape of each feature that passes the layer's filter before it is classed and
drawn, as MapServer transforms each shape it reads. Absent, there is none.

label_cache.description:
Whether the layer's labels go to the label cache, MapServer's `LABELCACHE`: placed with
the labels of every layer and drawn after them. Without the cache, each label is drawn at
once after its feature, untested against any other. Absent, it is true, MapServer's
default `LABELCACHE ON`. `post_label_cache` overrides it: a layer drawn after the label
cache draws its labels at once whatever this says.

max_features.description:
The most features the layer draws, MapServer's limit of `msLayerGetMaxFeaturesToDraw`:
the layer's `MAXFEATURES`, or its `maxfeaturestodraw` metadata, or the map's, or the output
format's `MAXFEATURESTODRAW`. The features past it, in the order the source returns them and
counted once their class is found, are not drawn, nor their labels. Absent, there is none.

min_scale_denom.description:
The layer is drawn at a scale above `min_scale_denom` and up to `max_scale_denom`; a
`max_scale_denom` of 0 bounds nothing.

opacity.description:
With an opacity, in percent from 0 to 100, the layer is drawn into a transparent image of
its own, which is laid over the map at that opacity; at 0 the layer is not drawn. Without
one, it is drawn straight onto the map.

post_label_cache.description:
Whether the layer is drawn after the label cache, MapServer's `POSTLABELCACHE TRUE`: past
every other layer and over every cached label, in its order among the layers of this kind,
its own labels drawn at once, never cached. Absent, it is false.

projection.description: The projection of the layer's features; without one, the map's.

size_units.description: The unit of its styles' sizes, widths, gaps, patterns, and offsets; without one, pixels.

symbol_scale_denom.description:
The scale, as MapServer computes it, at which the layer's symbols are drawn at their size
as written; at other scales their size scales with it.

oneOf.description: A proj4 string.

The projection the layer's source declares, read when it opens. Where it declares none,
its coordinates are longitude and latitude in the datum of the map's projection.
Always drawn, whatever a request asks for.

both_sides.description: Drawn on both sides of the line, MapServer's `-999`.

Map.description: A map: its image, its extent, and its layers in drawing order.

def_resolution.description:
The resolution the map's pixel lengths are written for, in dpi; MapServer's default is 72.
Every length in pixels is drawn scaled by `resolution` over this. A reader drops a value
outside 10 to 1000 with a warning, as MapServer's loader refuses one.

fonts.description:
The map's fonts by name, each a resource path inside the base context, not read at load.
Names match without regard to case, as MapServer's font set compares them, so no two
differ only in case: a reader leaves out a name that matches one written before it
without regard to case, with a warning naming both, and uses the first written.

label_cache_edge_buffer.description:
The pixels along the image's edges that no cached label reaches into unless it may be
partial or is forced, MapServer's `labelcache_map_edge_buffer` of `WEB` `METADATA`. Absent,
there is none.

projection.description: The map's projection as a proj4 string.

resolution.description:
The resolution of the image in dpi; MapServer's default is 72. A reader drops a value
outside 10 to 1000 with a warning, as MapServer's loader refuses one.

size.description: Width and height of the image in pixels.

symbols.description:
The map's symbols in MapServer's order: those of its `SYMBOL` blocks, then those of its
symbol set, then the image files its styles name. The one at position `i` has MapServer's
index `i + 1`; index 0 is MapServer's default symbol, a filled circle of size 1, which the
list leaves out.

units.description:
The unit of the map's coordinates, which the scale and sizes in other units are computed
in; MapServer's default is meters.

NotDrawn.description:
Why the engine does not draw a transform: the first construct of the expression, in its
reading order, the tree has no node for.

oneOf.description: A property's value where a number or a text is due.
A computed `smoothsia` preprocessing.
A shape `fromtext` reads from a text.
An operation of literals that folds to no finite JSON number, a `%` by 0 among them.
An expression MapServer's grammar does not parse as a shape, a `/` by 0 among them.

NumberOp.description: The operators of a number argument.

oneOf.description: The remainder of the operands cut to C's `int`s, MapServer's `(int)$1 % (int)$3`.

Op.description: The operators of CQL2 an expression uses, and the functions for what CQL2 lacks.

oneOf.description: A property's value as a number, as C's `atof` reads it: its longest numeric prefix, or 0.

A value as text: a property's value as it stands, a condition's as `true` or `false`, as
MapServer's parser gives a logical value where a string is asked for.
A property's value as a time, as MapServer's `msParseTime` reads it.
`regexp_like(value, pattern, flags)`: the pattern in PCRE2's syntax, byte mode (ADR-0015), the flag `i`.
`tostring(number, format)`: the number formatted by a C `printf` format.
Midpoints added about every point whose window is whole.
Midpoints added about every point whose window's path turns.

RenderMode.description:
How a layer's features are drawn, independent of their geometry type: polygons in a line
layer are drawn as their outlines.

oneOf.description: Labels only, no geometry.

ShapeType.description: The type of an inline feature's shape.

SourceRef.description: Where a layer's data lives, kept unparsed for a resolver to bind to an adapter.

Style_LabelTransform.description:
A style of a class, whose transform may be absent, or, as `Style<LabelTransform>`, of a label,
whose transform may not.

auto_angle.description:
Whether the symbol turns with the direction of the line it is drawn on, MapServer's
`ANGLE AUTO`.

gap.description:
The distance between symbols drawn along a line; a negative one turns them with the line,
a positive one keeps them upright.

geom_transform.description:
The geometry the style draws instead of the feature's own: on a class's style, the
feature's own where it is absent; on a label's style, where the style draws about the
label, never absent.

initial_gap.description: The distance before the first symbol or dash along a line.

line_join_max_size.description: How far a miter join may reach, as a multiple of the width.

line_offset.description:
A line drawn parallel to the feature's line at this distance, positive to its right in
the direction of drawing on the image, as MapServer's offset curve places it; MapServer
writes it as `OFFSET d -99`, or `-999` for both sides.

min_scale_denom.description: The style draws at a scale from `min_scale_denom` up to below `max_scale_denom`.

min_size.description: The bounds of the scaled size and width, in pixels at the map's `def_resolution`.

offset.description: A shift of what is drawn, `[x, y]`, y downwards.

outline_width.description: The width of a symbol's outline in pixels.

pattern.description: Dash and gap lengths, alternating, 2 to 10 of them.

polar_offset.description: A shift by distance and angle in degrees, `[distance, angle]`.

symbol.description: The symbol drawn, by its name or MapServer's index into the symbol set.

Style_Nullable_GeomTransform.description:
A style of a class, whose transform may be absent, or, as `Style<LabelTransform>`, of a label,
whose transform may not.

Whether the symbol turns with the direction of the line it is drawn on, MapServer's
`ANGLE AUTO`.

min_scale_denom.description: The style draws at a scale from `min_scale_denom` up to below `max_scale_denom`.

min_size.description: The bounds of the scaled size and width, in pixels at the map's `def_resolution`.

offset.description: A shift of what is drawn, `[x, y]`, y downwards.

outline_width.description: The width of a symbol's outline in pixels.

pattern.description: Dash and gap lengths, alternating, 2 to 10 of them.

polar_offset.description: A shift by distance and angle in degrees, `[distance, angle]`.

symbol.description: The symbol drawn, by its name or MapServer's index into the symbol set.

anchor_point.description:
The point of the symbol placed on the feature, as fractions of its extent; without one,
the centre.

character.description: The glyph of a TrueType symbol, and its font by the name the font set gives it.

extent.description:
The width and height of a vector symbol or an ellipse, as MapServer measures them. A
style's size is the symbol's height drawn, or its width where it has no height.

image.description:
The image of a pixmap or SVG symbol: a resource path inside the base context, not read at
load (Q-8).

paths.description:
A vector symbol's lines, each a list of `[x, y]`, y downwards, shifted as MapServer shifts
them so that none is negative; an ellipse's one point, its width and height.

transparent.description: The palette index of a pixmap that draws transparent.

SymbolRef.description:
A symbol of the map's symbol set: by MapServer's index, in which 0 is the default symbol, or by
its name: the first symbol of that name, without regard to case, as MapServer's
`msGetSymbolIndex` finds it. A name no symbol carries draws nothing.

TransformNumber.description: A number argument: a number, the map's cellsize in the layer's units, or an operation of two numbers.

TransformShape.description: A shape the tree computes: the feature's shape, or a function of a shape.

TransformTree.description: A `GEOMTRANSFORM` expression: a tree of the functions of a shape the engine draws, or the reason it does not draw the transform.

oneOf.description: Decimal degrees.
